stem:
Walia's father has type 2 diabetes. The doctor explains how the family should manage this non-communicable disease through medicine, physical activity, heart-disease risk, checkups, diet, exercise, and lifestyle.

Which statement gives the correct approach?

options.text: One complete course of diabetes medicine will cure him permanently, so no further care is needed.
Reducing his physical activity will lower his risk of heart disease.
He needs continuous care, regular checkups, a balanced diet, and daily exercise to manage the disease.
Since he looks healthy, he does not need regular checkups or any change in lifestyle.

teacher.key_rationale: Type 2 diabetes needs continuous care, checkups, diet, and exercise. One medicine course omits ongoing management. Less activity reverses the activity–risk link. Looking healthy captures appearance over need for care.
